verdict.rationale: ClickUp's product page lists "Whiteboards" among its own features, so a whiteboard capability exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how it works, including whether teams can edit together in real time. The Figma embed integration is a third-party design-collaboration route and does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documentation of shared or real-time multi-user whiteboard editing, visual collaboration features (shapes, sticky notes, comments, cursors), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
